response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong technical engineering fundamentals with 20 years of experience and excellent teaching/mentoring abilities, he falls significantly short on the core requirements for this AI Strategy role. His AI expertise is nascent (4 months at re:cinq working on AI infrastructure), with no demonstrated track record of building AI products or platforms. More critically, the role requires director-level strategic advisory and customer-facing influence, whereas his career shows exclusively individual contributor and technical leadership positions. He lacks the cloud platform strategy expertise and proven AI domain authority necessary for this principal-level position.
strengths: 20 years of diverse technical engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded systems, and infrastructure with strong software craftsmanship practices
Demonstrated ability to inspire and teach others through organizing workshops, courses, and conference talks, which aligns with the mentoring responsibility
Current exposure to AI infrastructure and emerging technologies (MCP frameworks, agentic workflows) at re:cinq shows recent relevant initiative
concerns: Minimal AI expertise and no demonstrated products or platforms built with AI—critical gap for an AI Strategy role despite recent exposure at re:cinq
No evidence of director-level strategic advisory experience or customer/partner advisory roles; career consists of individual contributor and technical staff positions
Limited cloud platform architecture and strategy expertise—AWS CDK mentioned but insufficient depth for cloud product strategy leadership
